# SK0216 — The argument naming style is not arranged

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

`skala arrange` would add or remove argument names under the configured style.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Formatting |
| Default severity | suggestion |
| Scope | Semantic |
| Needs a compilation | yes |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 2.0 |

## Why

Adding a name requires the resolved parameter; removing one is safe only when the argument already occupies that parameter's position. The rule binds the selected overload and preserves names that carry ordering semantics.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
Move(x: 1, y: 2);
```

Write:

```csharp
Move(1, 2);
```

## When it does not fire

Unresolved calls, out-of-position arguments and expanded `params` arguments that cannot legally be named are left alone.

## Configuration

- `resharper_csharp_arguments_literal`
- `resharper_csharp_arguments_string_literal`
- `resharper_csharp_arguments_anonymous_function`
- `resharper_csharp_arguments_named`
- `resharper_csharp_arguments_other`
- `resharper_csharp_arguments_skip_single`
